en.headline: IOMed settles Malaysian infrastructure dispute on first anniversary
en.dek: The Hong Kong-based International Organisation for Mediation resolved a construction dispute in Malaysia on Tuesday, its second successful case since launching operations.
body: The International Organisation for Mediation, headquartered in Hong Kong, successfully settled an infrastructure dispute in Malaysia on Tuesday as the body marked its first anniversary.

Secretary-General Teresa Cheng told guests at a reception that the case was brought by a party offering mediation without a prior agreement, and was completed in one day at the organisation’s Wan Chai headquarters. She said another case was being handled online and that the body had received more than a dozen inquiries.

Cheng described the outcome as demonstrating the institution’s value in facilitating settlement even without a pre-existing mediation agreement. The Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Hong Kong, Cui Jianchun, reaffirmed Beijing’s support for the organisation at the event.

zh.headline: 國際調解院成立一周年 成功調解馬來西亞基建爭議
zh.dek: 總部設於香港的國際調解院周二成功調解一宗馬來西亞基建爭議，為機構自運作以來第二宗成功個案。
body: 國際調解院在成立一周年之際，於周二成功調解一宗涉及馬來西亞基建項目的爭議。
秘書長鄭若馮在慶祝活動上表示，該個案由一方主動提出調解，事前並無調解協議，並在灣仔總部一天內完成。她指機構另有一宗個案正以網上方式處理，並已接獲十多宗查詢。
鄭若馮形容個案展示了機構即使在沒有事先協議的情況下，仍能促成調解和解。外交部駐香港特派員公署特派員崔建春在活動上重申中央對國際調解院的支持。
